Everyone was complaining a couple of days ago saying that they preferred if features don’t get merged in till they get SFI-ed. that’s not a thing anymore either btw so... what dont you get? we cant just implement every PR thats on consensus-specs unmerged the earlier that i do it, the more likely it is to change. at the very least i'd like the PR completed - but its hard to say 'devnet based on this release plus all these random PRs' compared to 'devnet based on this release'... i didnt think that was unreasonable im not saying dont merge till SFI, i think thats unreasonable
